how: Cooper Music School (Ensemble Schools) lists harp lessons in Atlanta for any age and level, and independent teachers at the Atlanta Harp Center teach adults from scratch with rental harps.
Dad's Garage Theatre runs improv and sketch classes for adults with free open-house sample classes, and The Basement Theatre also offers improv classes.
Atlanta School of Musical Arts on Lavista Road teaches piano and music production lessons, including for adults.
Atlanta School of Musical Arts and The Music Studio Atlanta offer piano lessons for adults and children, and Georgia Academy of Music is a nonprofit teaching piano to all ages.
Beginner and intro pole classes run at The Milan Method, The Secret Garden Pole Fitness Boutique and Vertical Joe's Westside Midtown, bookable through ClassPass.

area: West End / Joseph E. Lowery Blvd

how: Dance With Me in Midtown teaches salsa and bachata to solo students, and SALSAtlanta, PASOFino and Aatma Dance Studio run group classes for all levels.
Laughing Skull Lounge hosts open mics Monday to Wednesday and a multi-week stand-up class with a graduation show, and Dad's Garage runs stand-up sample classes.
Dance With Me lists swing dance lessons in Atlanta, taught to solo students without partners.
An Atlanta Indian arts directory lists a tabla teacher and the Indian Music Academy in Marietta among local Indian classical music schools.
The Indian Music Academy in Marietta and other schools in an Atlanta Indian arts directory teach Indian classical instruments.
Callanwolde Fine Arts Center runs eight-week beginning handbuilding courses teaching pinch, coil and slab methods.
Decatur Glassblowing offers beginner hot-shop classes for one to three people, typically making a sculpted flower or blown ornament, and Duckbill Studios in Scottdale also offers classes.
FlameTree Glass is a torchwork studio offering public and private lampworking classes.
Atlanta Glass runs an in-person Stained Glass Fundamentals course covering cutting, foiling and soldering.
Atlanta Printmakers Studio offers multi-week courses and one-day workshops in etching alongside screen printing and relief printing.
Atlanta Printmakers Studio runs screen printing courses and workshops with open studio access.
Atlanta Printmakers Studio teaches relief, etching, screen and letterpress printing; stone lithography itself was not found among its listed courses.
MASS Collective, a Castleberry Hill makerspace, offers workshop memberships and classes in wood, metal and leather, and Decatur Makers and Freeside Atlanta also have woodshops.
MASS Collective lists classes and memberships covering leather alongside wood, metal and glass.
MASS Collective offers metal workshop access and classes, though a dedicated beginner blacksmithing forge class was not confirmed.
CourseHorse lists Atlanta jewelry classes covering wire wrapping, beading and metalworking, and MASS Collective offers metal classes.
Candlefish's chandlery studio at Ponce City Market runs candle-making workshops where participants pour two jar candles.
Fabricate Studios runs weaving, sewing and macrame wall-hanging workshops.
Fabricate Studios offers weaving instruction from about $40 as part of its craft workshops.
Atlanta Craft Club hosts bring-your-own-craft nights and workshops, and The Beehive offers knitting and felting courses.
CourseHorse lists Atlanta embroidery classes from basic stitches to advanced designs.
Callanwolde Fine Arts Center runs black-and-white darkroom workshops with chemistry included, and The Photographer's Studio is a nonprofit community darkroom.
A 2-hour Intro to Cinema Cameras class is offered in Atlanta for beginners.
Digital Photo Academy runs guided photo shoots such as at Oakland Cemetery, and Callanwolde offers photography courses.
CourseHorse lists beginner and advanced origami classes in Atlanta.
Chastain Arts Center offers figure drawing and ACCC runs adult life-drawing courses with live models.
Dawn Art Studios teaches acrylic and oil painting to adults of all levels, and Chastain Arts Center and the High Museum run painting classes.
Chastain Arts Center and CourseHorse listings offer watercolor classes for adults in Atlanta.
Decatur Makers (Decatur) and Freeside Atlanta (West End) offer 3D printers and classes to members and the public.
Decatur Makers lists laser cutters among its shop tools, and Freeside Atlanta has a CO2 laser cutter and runs classes.
Freeside Atlanta has a small CNC router and metal shop, and Decatur Makers has metalworking and CNC-capable tools.
Freeside Atlanta is a nonprofit hackerspace in West End and Decatur Makers has an electronics shop, both hosting classes.
Freeside Atlanta and Decatur Makers host electronics and Arduino-style classes and open build nights.
The North Fulton Amateur Radio League in Roswell lists entry-level license classes and exam sessions in the ARRL club directory.
Georgia Tech hosts hackathons such as Ramblin' Hacks and the 36-hour AI ATL, though participation may favor students.
The DC404 meetup at Manuel's Tavern ran a hands-on CTF session, and OWASP Atlanta holds security meetups.
Atlanta has an active meetup scene including Refactr.Tech code jams and many tech groups listed in a local meetup tour.
The Atlanta Watch Society hosted half-day watchmaking classes with the Horological Society of New York in January 2026; they are occasional rather than regular.
The Escape Gamebar in Brookhaven combines pinball, arcade and light-gun games with escape rooms, and Joystick Gamebar is another game bar.
Manuel's Tavern hosts a weekly beginner-friendly board game meetup, and local game stores run learn-to-play sessions.
Atlanta Checkmate Club runs weekly chess nights in bars such as Ladybird Grove and Politan Row, and Atlanta Chess Mess meets at Manuel's Tavern.
The Bridge Club of Atlanta is an ACBL-sanctioned duplicate club, among the largest in North America, with Midtown Bridge Club and others in the metro.
Atlanta RPG Meetup runs D&D and other tabletop RPG games several nights a week, providing dice and character sheets to first-timers.
The Escape Gamebar and Time to Escape in Brookhaven and Beat the Bomb on the Upper Westside run escape rooms.
Gaming lounges with high-end PCs and consoles offer hourly or day-pass play and tournaments across Midtown, Downtown and suburbs.
Atlanta has VR arcades and free-roam arenas with wireless headsets and staff help, plus VR escape rooms.

how: Atlanta-area game stores run regular Magic: The Gathering, Pokemon and Yu-Gi-Oh! tournaments including Friday Night Magic.
Battle & Brew in Sandy Springs is a game bar hosting tabletop and geek events, and Atlanta game stores stock Warhammer.
Battle & Brew in Sandy Springs runs weekly Geek Trivia nights.
Dragon Con in downtown Atlanta hosts a major cosplay contest and Battle & Brew runs cosplay nights.
The Painted Pin in Buckhead is a boutique bowling bar, and Pin and Proper in Grant Park offers bowling variants.
Schoolhouse Brewing in Marietta runs a homebrew supply store and Homebrew University classes.

how: Cook's Warehouse in Piedmont Heights teaches baking and cake classes at $99-110, though bread-specific sessions were not confirmed.
The Distillery of Modern Art in Chamblee offers monthly cocktail creation classes and CourseHorse lists Atlanta mixology classes.
The Metro Atlanta Beekeepers Association runs an annual one-day beginner course with in-hive sessions at teaching apiaries, and Dunwoody Nature Center has offered beekeeping classes.
Atlanta gets too little snow for snow sculpture; the nearest reliable snow is in the North Carolina mountains, about 3 hours away by car.
